title: Truncated backpropagation through time induces a two-sided gradient turnpike property
abstract: arXiv:2611.07415v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Truncated backpropagation through time reduces the computational burden of training recurrent models by restricting gradient computations to shorter temporal contexts. This induces two distinct boundary effects: missing past information perturbs the forward state evolution, while truncating the backward recursion omits future information. This motivates decoupling the interval over which gradient contributions are averaged for the parameter update from the surrounding temporal context over which they are computed. Under exponential decay of the state-transition Jacobians and mild regularity conditions, this leads to a two-sided gradient turnpike property: the error between truncated- and full-context gradient contributions decays exponentially with the distance from both context boundaries. We derive bounds for the averaged update gradient, yielding guarantees on gradient alignment and approximate full-context stationarity; under unbia

translated_title: 截断的时间反向传播诱导双边梯度巡回性质
translated_abstract: 截断的时间反向传播通过将梯度计算限制在较短的时间上下文中，降低了循环模型训练的计算负担。这会引发两种不同的边界效应：缺失过去的信息会扰动前向状态演化，而截断反向递推则会遗漏未来的信息。这促使我们将用于参数更新的梯度贡献的平均区间与其计算时所处的周围时间上下文解耦开来。在状态转移雅可比矩阵指数衰减及适度的正则性条件下，这导致了一个双边梯度巡回性质：截断上下文与完整上下文梯度贡献之间的误差随距离两侧上下文边界的距离呈指数衰减。我们为平均更新梯度推导了界，从而为梯度对齐性和近似完整上下文的平稳性提供了保证；在无偏……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明，在状态转移雅可比矩阵指数衰减等温和条件下，截断的时间反向传播具有“双边梯度巡回性质”，即截断与完整上下文的梯度贡献误差随远离两侧边界而指数衰减，从而为梯度对齐和近似完整上下文平稳性提供理论保证。
en_tdlr: Under exponential decay of state-transition Jacobians, truncated backpropagation through time exhibits a two-sided gradient turnpike property—truncation errors decay exponentially away from both context boundaries—yielding guarantees on gradient alignment and approximate full-context stationarity.
